title: Jawaharlal Nehru
summary: Closes the Objectives Resolution debate, argues that constitution-making can no longer wait, defends popular sovereignty in the States and moves the Bhutan-Sikkim resolution.

title: H. J. Khandekar
summary: Suggests passing the Objectives Resolution on 26 January to connect the constitutional declaration with Independence Day.

title: Syamanandan Sahaya
summary: Withdraws his two remaining amendments before the final reply and vote.

title: Mohan Lal Saksena
summary: Reads the Urdu translation of the Objectives Resolution immediately before the standing vote.

title: Govind Ballabh Pant
summary: Seconds the resolution extending the States Negotiating Committee's scope to Bhutan and Sikkim.

title: H. V. Kamath
summary: Requests a no-business day as a tribute marking Subhas Chandra Bose's golden jubilee.

title: N. V. Gadgil
summary: Moves sanction of the Constituent Assembly's estimated expenditure for 1946–47 and 1947–48.

title: K. Santhanam
summary: Moves that the Assembly budget be considered in Committee and in camera.

title: N. G. Ranga
summary: Seconds the proposal to take the budget into Committee.

title: Sri Biswanath Das
summary: Supports consideration of the Assembly budget in Committee.

title: Somnath Lahiri
summary: Questions excluding the public from a discussion dealing with public money.

title: Dr. Rajendra Prasad
summary: Conducts closure and the standing vote, reads the Resolution and manages the day's subsequent business.
